# MeasurementInducedNonlinearity

**Domain**: iNEST
**First mentioned**: auto-extracted
**Last updated**: 2026-08-04

## Definition
Nonlinear computational effects arising from the backaction of measurements on the quantum reservoir state, distinct from unitary evolution. Provides a resource for complex temporal processing in neuromorphic systems without requiring explicit nonlinear gates.
